p: Thus the Scripture refers to the prophets.
dwelling place in all generations: You have been as a house and defence to us in all our troubles and travels now this four hundred years.
mountains were brought forth: You have chosen us to be your people before the foundations of the world were laid.
turnest man to destruction: Moses by lamenting the frailty and shortness of man's life moves God to pity.

For a thousand years in thy: Though man thinks his life is long, which is indeed most short, yet though it were a thousand years, yet in God's sight it is as nothing, and as the watch that lasts only three hours.
carriest them away as with a: You take them away suddenly as with a flood.
consumed by thine anger: You called us by the rods to consider the storms of our life and for our sins you shorten our days.
spend our years as a tale: Our days are not only short but miserable as our sins daily provoke your wrath.
fourscore years: Meaning according to the common state of life.
Who knoweth the power of thine: If man's life for the shortness of it is miserable, it is even more so if your wrath is on it, as they who fear you only know.
wisdom: Which is by considering the shortness of our life, and by meditating the heavenly joys.
how long: Meaning, will you be angry?
Let thy work appear unto thy: Even your mercy, which is the chiefest work.
children: As God's promises belong well to their poverty, as to them, so Moses prays for the posterity.
beauty of the LORD our God: Meaning, that is was obscured when he ceases to do good to his Church.
establish thou the work of our: For unless you guide us with your Holy Spirit, our enterprises cannot succeed.
